Constitution 1 (as the lane brief states it): mock only the true external boundary, third-party or paid APIs you do not control.
The audio prompt embeds today's date, so the request differs on every day it runs.

A recording keyed by the test and the order of its calls, holding the request it answered, can detect staleness by comparing that request with the live one once known volatile text (dates, the model name) is normalized.
